answer: An identity buys its seat with Shipwright plank trial lodged with the shipwrights charter; the price of the seat is 3-year apprenticeship, 366 supervised planks, guild exam, 39 POA annual fee, renewal. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 454 fakes pay 454 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill outruns its reward. A cedar earned slowly, a island paid plainly, and a prism kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. This is the point: the cost falls on the attacker, never on the honest agent.
